Team Rocket

Released April 24, 2000 · 83 cards

Team Rocket is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Base series, released in English on April 24, 2000. Its main set has 82 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (83 in total). It includes 68 Pokémon, 11 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

9 illustrators worked on Team Rocket. Most cards: Kagemaru Himeno (22), Mitsuhiro Arita (21), Ken Sugimori (14), Sumiyoshi Kizuki (9), Atsuko Nishida (5), Shin-ichi Yoshida (4), Keiji Kinebuchi (3), Miki Tanaka (3).
